name: Honey Trap ~Yuuwaku no Kiss wa Koi no Wana~
original_name: ハニー×トラップ ～誘惑のキスは恋の罠～
source:
You're the daughter to the president of a major real estate company.
At a party, you find yourself surrounded by handsome men, who are also rich in character.
They set up their honey traps,
which you keep falling for, body and soul...

[translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151024024227/http://www.furyu.jp/mobile/otome/content_honeytrap.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
你是一家大型房地产公司总裁的女儿。
在一场派对上，一群英俊而各具魅力的男人，将你包围。
他们布下甜蜜的陷阱，
而你的身心，也一次次陷入其中……

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151024024227/http://www.furyu.jp/mobile/otome/content_honeytrap.html]官方网站[/url]]
